==Enemies==
'''Ice''' may refer to these enemies:
*[[Packed Ice]], an enemy that first appears on Wave 5 in [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode, and on Wave 5 on Easy difficulty and Wave 7 on Hard difficulty in [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)]]
**[[Packed Ice/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Unstable Ice]], an enemy that stuns towers on death, that first appears on Wave 16 in [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode, and on Wave 17 on Easy difficulty and Wave 20 on Hard difficulty in [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)]]
**[[Unstable Ice/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Ice Beacon]], a summoned enemy spawned by the [[Frost Spirit]] in [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode and [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)]].

'''Ice''' may refer to these event enemies:
*[[Packed Ice (Krampus Frosthold)]], an enemy that first appeared on Wave 10 in [[Krampus Frosthold]].
**[[Packed Ice (Krampus Frosthold)/Advanced Stats]]
*[[Packed Ice (Frost Invasion)]], an enemy that first appeared on Wave 7 in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)]].
*[[Unstable Ice (Frost Invasion)]], an enemy that stuns towers on death, that first appeared on Wave 11 in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)]].
